subject.title: [Feature]: muteKeywords channel config — drop messages matching keyword/regex list before agent dispatch

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in per-channel content filter such as `muteKeywords`, and should that live as shared channel policy or as Slack/Discord-owned plugin config?
rationale: The request adds a new config surface that silently suppresses inbound messages and accepts regex-like operator input, so implementation should wait for maintainer policy on scope, naming, safety, and drop-history semantics.

options.title: Require design first
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the config name, channel scope, regex safety contract, and dropped-history behavior.

options.title: Approve narrow Slack/Discord filter
options.body: Allow a focused implementation limited to Slack and Discord channel config with strict schema, docs, and tests.

options.title: Decline new config
options.body: Close after documenting existing mention, bot-loop, and scoped mention-pattern controls as the supported ways to reduce channel noise.

recommendation.title: Require design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the config name, channel scope, regex safety contract, and dropped-history behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows repeated work across the central channel config and inbound gating paths touched by the proposed feature.
